# CANDIDATE: COMBINED_STRUCTURE_AND_TRENDLINE_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Combining the structure veto (blocking bear put trades into confirmed 5m uptrends) and the trendline break call veto (blocking call trades on broken ascending support) will avoid losses on J's loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07) while preserving all three PUT winner day trades (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). The structure veto already removes two wrong-way bear put losers (net −$574) and the call veto blocks the 5/07 call losers (−$165), potentially increasing edge_capture from base 780 to ~1519 if winner day P&L remains intact.

## Mechanism

Entry requires BOTH:
1. `structure_veto_enabled` = False (i.e., `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` does NOT classify as P-in-uptrend or C-in-downtrend on 5m same-day bars)
2. `trendline_break_call_veto_enabled` = False (i.e., no 5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support break detected for CALL entries)
Exit logic unchanged: chandelier profit-lock arms at +5% favor, trails 0.15 off HWM; primary stop is chart-stop (SPY closes 3-min candle above rejected level +$0.50 buffer for PUTs, below reclaimed level +$0.50 for CALLS); premium stop is catastrophe cap only (−50% Safe, −7% bear/−5% bull Bold); time stop 15:50 ET.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (unchanged from base engine)
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = ~342 trading days (16 months); selection method = all bars passing base engine filters; overfit risk = high due to anchoring on only 6 J days; requires walk-forward and regime testing to validate persistence of structure/trendline break signals.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (held-out window not yet tested)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J day real-fill validation pending)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: gap open against position on winner day (e.g., 4/29 gap down) triggering chart-stop before ribbon ride develops
   - Max drawdown: estimated improvement from base −$2,273 due to loser day avoidance, but dependent on winner day consistency
   - Blow-up scenario: simultaneous failure of both vetoes during volatile regime (e.g., FOMC day) allowing multiple loser day entries
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L
